sourceIntent: LAMBS doFleeing can retain a calm actor under cover rather than selecting another escape, and otherwise returns to native formation. Its forced DOWN/doStop, blanket posture/speed/medical state changes and vehicle seat action workers are not imported.
finding: CBE current material-screen check was below the quiet native rejoin branch. A valid quiet distant group belief could therefore request FOLLOW out of an already screened position before that protection was evaluated.
implementation: Evaluate the existing material-screen observation before both quiet rejoin and screened escape search, under the original group2second and actor15second search clocks.

If screened, issue no CBE movement, hold, posture, suppression, medical or speed command. Native engine and mission ownership remain unchanged. No cover reservation, safe-room verdict or all-threat protection is claimed.

Unscreened actors retain original quiet rejoin and escape policies, original maximum12second travel lease and native return observation/cleanup. No route search expansion, new worker/timer/handler or clock renewal.
cost: Non-quiet path retains its existing one material-screen observation. Previously successful quiet rejoin now performs that observation: at most one terrain intersection and one object ray returning four surfaces. Same group2second/actor15second throttle; no entity enumeration or retained cache. Physical reaction and overall overhead require measurement.
